provenance: Controller-assigned stable finding IDs. Observation text unchanged from actual accountant agent report. Not an isolated browser-worker receipt.

findings.finding: After both original approvals, Lena reviewer view simultaneously showed Ready to pay / 2 of 2 and Two approvers must review this amount / Switch demo role to a named approver to review.
findings.impact: An accountant can unnecessarily revisit completed approvals or doubt readiness.
findings.recommendation: Make reviewer guidance depend on approval count: show Both approvals are in; switch to payment operator, while preserving access to the credit action.

findings.finding: After both revised approvals were recorded, the payment panel still said Amount changed after review. Approve the revised 800 Test USD, even with Ready to pay and enabled Pay 800.
findings.impact: The primary callout asks for work already completed at the moment of payment.
findings.recommendation: Replace the imperative after 2 of 2 with Revised 800 Test USD approved, or hide it once approvals are current.

findings.finding: Apply supplier credit is disabled for approvers without adjacent explanation of the required reviewer role.
findings.recommendation: Name Lena / Finance reviewer beside the disabled control or show a concise role hint.

findings.finding: Evidence labels original 1,000 approval events as generic Rehearsal record, with present-tense Approval covers this amount, recipient and current invoice version; expiry must be inferred from the later credit event or side-panel disclosure.
findings.recommendation: Mark historical approval records Expired after CN-2026-084 and include their invoice version in human-readable evidence.

findings.finding: Export evidence downloads JSON, although label does not identify format.
findings.recommendation: Label export format and consider a printable accounting evidence summary alongside JSON.
